headlines.title: ConocoPhillips (COP) Stock Looks Like A Bargain After Fresh Results
headlines.summary: ConocoPhillips has delivered a powerful run in recent years, and with earnings in focus after fresh results and a higher dividend, the key question is whether the current share price still lines up with what the business is earning. Over the past 5 years the stock has gained 127.4%, which puts real pressure on the idea that its earnings can comfortably carry today's valuation.

headlines.title: Bernstein cuts ConocoPhillips and Diamondback ratings as Iran de-escalation looms
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Bernstein downgraded ConocoPhillips (NYSE: COP), Diamondback Energy (NASDAQ: FANG) and Devon Energy (NYSE: DVN) to Market-Perform, saying oil stocks may struggle as tensions between the U.S. and Iran ease after the midterm elections.

description: ConocoPhillips explores for, produces, transports, and markets crude oil, bitumen, natural gas, liquefied natural gas (LNG), and natural gas liquids. It operates in five segments: Alaska; Lower 48; Canada; Europe, Middle East and North Africa; and Asia Pacific. The company's portfolio includes unconventional plays in North America; conventional assets in North America, Europe, Asia, and Australia; global LNG developments; oil sands assets in Canada; and an inventory of global exploration prospects. It serves in the United States, Canada, China, Equatorial Guinea, Libya, Malaysia, Norway, Singapore, the United Kingdom, and internationally. ConocoPhillips was founded in 1917 and is headquartered in Houston, Texas.
